videos.caption: A complete beginner can make any of these 5 digital products this week, and each one has real reviews on screen so you can see people are actually buying these. If you don't know what a digital product is — it's just a file. Nothing to ship, nothing to store. 1. A checklist — a list of steps someone ticks off, like a packing checklist for a holiday. 2. A planner — like a meal planner. Everyone has to eat. 3. A spreadsheet template — Google Sheets is free, and people copy your sheet and type in their own numbers. 4. A study guide — a short guide that sums up one subject for an exam. 5. A pack of ready-made AI prompts — write the questions once, the buyer pastes them in. Each one does one small job and can be made in an afternoon. Pick the one closest to something you already do. The mistake people make is starting too big — start with one small job and one very small digital product that solves a very specific problem.
